package ratpack.session;

import java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException;
import java.security.InvalidKeyException;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;

public interface Signer {

  /**
   * Signs a message using the application's secret key
   *
   * @param message The message to sign
   * @return The message signed with the application's secret key
   * @throws UnsupportedEncodingException
   * @throws InvalidKeyException
   * @throws NoSuchAlgorithmException
   */
  public String sign(String message) throws UnsupportedEncodingException, InvalidKeyException, NoSuchAlgorithmException;


  /**
   * Signs a message using a given secret
   *
   * @param message The message to sign
   * @param key The secret used to sign the message
   * @return The message signed with the given secret key
   * @throws UnsupportedEncodingException
   * @throws InvalidKeyException
   * @throws NoSuchAlgorithmException
   */
  public String sign(String message, byte[] key) throws UnsupportedEncodingException, InvalidKeyException, NoSuchAlgorithmException;

}

steps.final_code:
package ratpack.handling;

import ratpack.func.NoArgAction;

public interface ByContentSpec {

  /**
   * Specifies that the given block should be used if the client wants content of the given MIME type.
   * This only supports fully-specified content types (no "*" wildcards).
   *
   * @param mimeType The MIME type to register for
   * @param block    The block to invoke if the content type matches
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec type(String mimeType, NoArgAction block);

  /**
   * Specifies that the given HTTP handler should be used if the client wants content of the given MIME type.
   *
   * @param mimeType The MIME type to register for
   * @param handler  The handler to invoke if the content type matches
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec type(String mimeType, Handler handler);

  /**
   * Specifies that the given block should be used if the client wants content of type "text/plain".
   *
   * @param block The block to invoke if the content type matches
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec plainText(NoArgAction block);

  /**
   * Specifies that the given HTTP handler should be used if the client wants content of type "text/plain".
   *
   * @param handler The handler to invoke if the content type matches
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec plainText(Handler handler);

  /**
   * Specifies that the given block should be used if the client wants content of type "text/html".
   *
   * @param block The block to invoke if the content type matches
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec html(NoArgAction block);

  /**
   * Specifies that the given HTTP handler should be used if the client wants content of type "text/html".
   *
   * @param handler The handler to invoke if the content type matches
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec html(Handler handler);

  /**
   * Specifies that the given block should be used if the client wants content of type "application/json".
   *
   * @param block The block to invoke if the content type matches
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec json(NoArgAction block);

  /**
   * Specifies that the given HTTP handler should be used if the client wants content of type "application/json".
   *
   * @param handler The handler to invoke if the content type matches
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec json(Handler handler);

  /**
   * Specifies that the given block should be used if the client wants content of type "application/xml".
   *
   * @param block The block to invoke if the content type matches
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec xml(NoArgAction block);

  /**
   * Specifies that the given HTTP handler should be used if the client wants content of type "application/xml".
   *
   * @param handler The handler to invoke if the content type matches
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec xml(Handler handler);

  /**
   * Specifies that the given block should be used if the client's requested content type cannot be matched
   * with any of the other handlers.
   *
   * @param block The block to invoke if the content type doesn't match
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec noMatch(NoArgAction block);

  /**
   * Specifies that the given HTTP handler should be used if the client's requested content type cannot be matched
   * with any of the other handlers.
   *
   * @param handler The handler to invoke if the content type doesn't match
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec noMatch(Handler handler);

  /**
   * Specifies that the handler for the specified content type should be used if the client's requested content type
   * cannot be matched with any of the other handlers. Effectively, this treats the request as if the user requested the specified MIME type.
   *
   * @param mimeType The MIME type to use as a fallback if the requested type can't be matched
   * @return this
   */
  ByContentSpec noMatch(String mimeType);
}
